Public cancel loads the original begin/authorize connection by operationId and verifies its stored CSR or certified key, S256 from verifier, connectionId=-, fixed cancel path and connection-cancel nonce. Other public proof actions load canonical connection/generation record and compare installation key, operation, exact origin/method/path, nonce, original challenge, full body hash. Restart uses previousConnectionId/original server nonce and old verifier; transcript codeChallenge is new requested challenge and body contains previous connection/old verifier/restart ticket. Public cert recovery requires approved original generation operation. Native actions instead require current actual Cloudflare mTLS leaf binding to verified installation key/current cert generation before accessing any operation. No generic invented RSA proof on already-mutually-authenticated native calls.

CONNECTION_REAUTHORIZE.dispatch: Shared /v1/connections selects this action only from the complete expectedGeneration+installationKeyId+proofNonce+proof field bundle; absence selects original initial begin; partial/mixed bundles rejected.

reauthorizationContextResolution.staging: Stored INSTALL connection includes expectedGeneration. CONNECTION_CLAIM stages its public expectedGeneration+1 certificate without changing installation generation. Initial installation without expectedGeneration retains generation1 behavior.
reauthorizationContextResolution.exchangeException: Only exact SESSION_EXCHANGE for this phone-approved grant and its original PKCE may use this exact staged DER/SPKI before main generation commit. Native main atomically checks old generation/current installation revision/slot snapshot and installs certificate+fresh personal grant/credentials. No other bootstrap/API/WSS accepts staged DER before commit. The exact staged leaf may also perform same-grant GRANT_REVOKE using only its precommitted revoke capability, including response-loss logout before deviceId is known.
reauthorizationContextResolution.revocation: Explicit local installation incident ban or exact CA leaf pending_reactivation/pending_revocation/revoked/unknown rejects; HTTP401/403 or expiry alone never imply CA revocation. CA GET never issues a new leaf. Existing grant expiry/revocation never changes to live.

capabilities.derivation: HMAC-SHA256 using original PKCE verifier ASCII as key and ASCII `WegoH native access v2 recovery\n`+grantId or `WegoH native access v2 revoke\n`+grantId as separate messages; canonical base64url32-byte result. Reuse Python hmac/hashlib primitives already in team_auth; declare vectors before Kotlin adoption.
capabilities.serverStorage: Separate SHA256(capability ASCII) by purpose and stable grantId. Revoke capability survives credentialEpoch/slotRevision rotation and optional scope shrink for that same grant only; it cannot restore/grant/read. Terminal revoke makes all personal credentials/recovery inactive but repeated matching revoke returns original terminal revokedAt without side effects; keep its hash through original grant absolute expiry, after which a validated expired acknowledgment permits outbox removal. Recovery capability also requires current grant/slot/credential epoch and active scopes; terminal grants never recover.
capabilities.clientStorage: Recovery capability remains only encrypted active-account state. Revoke outbox retains only revoke capability, grantId/deviceId, persisted operationId and installationKeyId/certificate generation binding. Native revoke uses actual mTLS key possession plus this revoke-only secret; original PKCE/access/refresh/recovery/server RSA nonce are not retained or needed. Never send it to generic data/refresh endpoints.

HMAC-SHA256 using original current begin PKCE verifier ASCII as key; message exact ASCII 'WegoH native access v2 revoke-before-exchange
'+installationKeyId+'
'+beginOperationId. Canonical base64url of32bytes. revokeCommitment uses existing hash_secret('revoke',capability) domain: SHA256 ASCII 'WegoH native v2 revoke

preExchangeRevocation.binding: Commitment is required in all fresh consent begin/restart/account-authorize/reauthorize exact request canonical hashes. Main phone approval stores it in that grant before any personal exchange. SESSION_EXCHANGE derives from its validated original verifier/key/begin operation and compares exact commitment; no late first exchange after revoke.
preExchangeRevocation.storage: Client retains only revoke-only capability/grantId/operation/key binding in encrypted logout outbox even without deviceId or credential receipt. Original verifier/access/refresh/recovery are removed from outbox. Before approval exists, local cancel is not claimed remote grant revocation.
preExchangeRevocation.idempotency: GRANT_REVOKE can terminalize APPROVED before device allocation or TOKEN_ISSUED after exchange. Repeat same valid capability returns original terminal timestamp. Expiry acknowledgement only after the same exact capability proof. No operation replay restores personal credentials.
preExchangeRevocation.stagedException: Exact staged reauthorization leaf is accepted only for its same grant SESSION_EXCHANGE or GRANT_REVOKE; technical renewal staged leaf is accepted only for its exact CREDENTIAL_REBIND or same-grant GRANT_REVOKE. All other native bootstrap/API/WSS deny staged leaf before main generation commit.
preExchangeRevocation.compatibility: Existing SESSION_REVOKE(deviceId path) remains supported. Technical cert renewal, refresh, recovery and scope shrink preserve the precommitted stable revoke capability; existing recovery derivation remains grantId-specific.
